_comment: Example playlist profiles. Copy to a file OUTSIDE git (e.g. under docs/ops-local/) and point PROFILES_FILE at it. A profile is a named, ordered selection of channel slugs the /api/playlist/{name}.m3u endpoint serves; slugs are the channel `slug` values from channels/seed.json. The built-in `default` profile (every live channel) always exists and cannot be overridden here. Only channels that resolve (status==live) at request time are emitted.
